sentences.japanese: 失礼ですが、上の記事にある誤りを三つ指摘させてください。
sentences.english: Excuse me; allow me to point out three errors in the above article.

sentences.japanese: 空き部屋は三つありますが、どれも使用できません。
sentences.english: We have three spare rooms, none of which can be used.

sentences.japanese: 京子がどこに住んでいるのか正確にはしりませんが、三ノ宮の方です。
sentences.english: I don't know exactly where Kyoko lives, but it's in the direction of Sannomiya.
Guests arrived by twos and threes.

sentences.japanese: 私たちの家が完成するまでに三カ月はかかるでしょうね。
sentences.english: It will be three months before our house is completed.
